# Third-party licences

The `md2pdf` binary embeds its dependencies rather than linking them at runtime, so the
crates below are the ones whose code can end up inside it. This file is that list and
the licence texts those crates carry, reproduced from the crates' own files. It is
generated — run `python3 tools/third-party-licenses.py` after a dependency change.

Resolved for `aarch64-apple-darwin`, normal dependencies only: a build-dependency runs
at build time and is not linked in, and a dev-dependency reaches no shipped artifact.

**It is a superset, deliberately.** The walk is over the resolve graph and not over an
enabled feature set, so a crate reached only through a feature this build does not turn
on is still listed — measured against `cargo tree -e normal`, eight are. Attributing a
crate that did not ship costs a reader nothing; omitting one that did is the failure
this file exists to prevent, so the error is taken in the safe direction and said out
loud rather than trimmed away.

The bundled fonts are not here — they are not crates. `core/assets/fonts/OFL.txt` and
`core/assets/fonts/GUST-FONT-LICENSE.txt` travel beside them in the published crate, and
the README names both.

**334 crates, 23 distinct licence expressions, 11 distinct terms.**
